items.title: Corn Parts Sorting Tray Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A four-compartment wooden tray holds a short corn-cob section, detached husk leaves, fine silk strands and loose kernels.
items.description: A four-compartment wooden tray holds a short corn-cob section, detached husk leaves, fine silk strands and loose kernels. Use this isolated illustration in a personal corn-themed design or classroom vocabulary activity.
